purpose: Bounded training-only comparison of weighted SCAFFOLD, matched FedAvg-SGD and centralized-SGD; not a new architecture or final evaluation
optimizer: Plain SGD with momentum0, constant lr and L2 included in the raw gradient; no clipping or adaptive optimizer
loss: sqrt_weighted_ce with fixed_train_mean denominator for all arms, so expected client gradients pool to the same weighted population objective
sampling: Uniform with replacement inside each client; exactly50 batches/client/round. Central samples uniformly from pooled TRAIN with1000 batches/round. FL arms have identical rows, order and dropout seeds. Central matches processed examples and optimizer calls, not the realized rows or optimization trajectory
weighted_formulation: p_i = assigned_rows_i / 2000000. Server weights BOTH model and control aggregates by p_i, not equal processed-example counts. Every client participates with equal K. c_i_new=c_i-c+(x-y_i)/(K*lr); c=sum p_i*c_i; server model lr1. All controls initialize zero
scope_changes_from_previous: SGD replaces reset Adam, fixed loss denominator replaces batch-weight denominator, equal sampled K replaces full unequal local epochs. These changes are shared by all three new arms; no improvement may be attributed to SCAFFOLD by comparing only with historical Adam
rationale: Source20 is the same collapsed model as the preceding rescue diagnostic. Ten rounds and lr0.01 are fixed engineering choices, not optimized settings. This is neither from-scratch training nor a proof that other SCAFFOLD settings would fail
first_round_bridge: Zero-control SCAFFOLD must reproduce same-code FedAvg-SGD weights, loss and sample hashes exactly; control identities independently checked
endpoint: Round10 of this continuation (source round30), never the best intermediate metric
screen_definition: Compare SCAFFOLD to matched FedAvg-SGD. Both rare recalls must not decline and false alerts may increase <=0.5pp. Then require either macro-F1 gain>=1pp, or at least one rare recall gain>=1pp with macro-F1 loss<=0.5pp. Report aggregate and rare-class evidence separately. Passing permits only separately planned confirmation, never a final-performance claim
controls: Preserve20 client variates and server variate between rounds. Test boundary serialization and independent replay; extra control vectors change training communication, not inference size
stopping: Stop on any numerical/invariant/bridge failure. No automatic retry at another lr, start, loss, K or budget. Complete10 rounds if finite; no extending the schedule after seeing metrics
reference: https://proceedings.mlr.press/v119/karimireddy20a/karimireddy20a.pdf Algorithm1 and Section4, weighted objective note in Section2
